home.title: Welcome to your closet
home.message: Add a few clothes and build an outfit, and today's look will appear here.

closet.title: Your closet is empty
closet.message: This is where all your clothes live. Photograph a piece to get started.

outfits.title: No outfits yet
outfits.message: Combine pieces from your closet into outfits and see them on you.

calendar.title: Nothing planned
calendar.message: Plan what to wear and keep a log of what you wore each day.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.heightInvalid: This does not look like a height. Check it or leave it empty.
profile.loadFailedTitle: Your profile could not be loaded
profile.loadFailedMessage: Nothing has been changed. Try again, and restart the app if this keeps happening.

backup.exportFailed: The backup could not be created.
backup.importConfirmMessage: Everything currently in the app will be replaced by the contents of the backup. This cannot be undone.
backup.importInvalid: This file is not a Closet backup. Nothing was changed.

ai.title: AI provider keys
ai.intro: AI features use your own provider accounts. Keys are stored only in this device's keychain and are never included in backups.

anthropic.name: Anthropic Claude
anthropic.purpose: Tags clothes from photos and styles outfits.

ai.rejected: The provider rejected this key. Check that it was copied completely and is still active.
ai.testFailed: The provider could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
ai.removeConfirmMessage: Features that use this provider will stop working until you add a key again.
ai.keyNeededMessage: This feature uses {{provider}}. Add your key in Settings to use it.

onboarding.welcomeMessage: Photograph your clothes, put outfits together and see them on yourself. A few questions first, so the app can dress you.
onboarding.genderMessage: This helps with outfit renders and suggestions. All clothing categories stay available whatever you choose.
onboarding.bodyTypeTitle: Which shape is closest to yours?
onboarding.bodyTypeMessage: Used only as a hint when rendering outfits on you.
onboarding.saveFailed: Your profile could not be saved. Please try again.

avatar.title: Your photo
avatar.guidance: Stand straight facing the camera in good light, in fitted clothes, with your whole body from head to feet in the frame. Ask someone to take it or use a timer.
avatar.removeConfirmMessage: The photo is deleted from this device. Outfit renders will ask for a new one.
avatar.privacy: Your photo stays on this device. It is sent to the image provider only when you ask for an outfit render.
avatar.denied: Closet has no access to the camera or your photos. You can allow it in the system settings.

issue.noPerson: No person was found in this photo. Outfit renders need a clear photo of you.
issue.severalPeople: There is more than one person in this photo. Renders work best with only you in it.
issue.cutOff: Part of your body seems to be outside the frame. Renders work best when you are visible from head to feet.
issue.tooSmall: You are quite small in this photo. Standing closer to the camera gives better renders.

closet.noResultsMessage: No item matches your search and filters.
closet.retagMessage: The values you choose replace the current ones on every selected item. Anything you leave empty stays as it is.
closet.deleteManyMessage: The items and their photos are removed from your closet.
closet.deleteManyUsedMessage: Outfits using these items: {{count}}. The items are removed from them too.

addItem.menuPhoto: Take a photo of an item
addItem.menuLink: Add an item from a shop link
addItem.title: New item
addItem.tip: Lay the piece flat or hang it on a plain background that contrasts with it, in even light, with the whole piece in the frame.
addItem.noCutout: The item could not be separated from its background, so the original photo is used.

tagsUnavailable.noKey: Automatic suggestions need an Anthropic key. You can fill in the details yourself.
tagsUnavailable.offline: No connection, so there are no automatic suggestions. You can fill in the details yourself.
tagsUnavailable.rejectedKey: The Anthropic key was rejected, so there are no automatic suggestions. You can fill in the details yourself.
tagsUnavailable.rateLimited: The provider is busy right now, so there are no automatic suggestions. You can fill in the details yourself.
tagsUnavailable.error: Automatic suggestions did not work this time. You can fill in the details yourself.

addItem.denied: Closet has no access to the camera. You can allow it in the system settings.
addItem.saveFailed: The item could not be saved. Please try again.

itemForm.name: Name
itemForm.priceInvalid: Enter the price as a number.
itemForm.purchasedAtInvalid: Enter the date as year-month-day, for example 2026-03-15.

item.title: Item
item.deleteMessage: The item and its photos are removed from your closet.
item.deleteUsedMessage: Outfits using this item: {{count}}. It is removed from them too.

importFlow.title: Import
importFlow.confirmMessage: Each photo becomes an item with its background removed and suggested details. With an Anthropic key, that is one request per photo.
importFlow.keepOpen: Importing continues while you use the app, and pauses when the app is closed.

linkImport.title: Add from a link
linkImport.useClipboard: Use the link on the clipboard
linkImport.chooseImage: Choose the photo that shows the item best, ideally without a person.

errors.invalidUrl: This does not look like a web link.
errors.unreachable: The page could not be opened. Some shops block apps from reading their pages.
errors.noProduct: No product was found on this page.
errors.download: The photo could not be downloaded.

outfitEditor.empty: Pick pieces below to build an outfit.
outfitEditor.notNeeded: Not needed with a dress or jumpsuit.
outfitEditor.noItems: Nothing in your closet for this yet. Tap to add an item.
outfitEditor.discardMessage: This outfit has changes that are not saved.

outfits.title: Outfit
outfits.name: Name
outfits.noResultsMessage: No saved outfit has these filters.
outfits.deleteMessage: The outfit is removed. Its pieces stay in your closet.

tryOn.inProgress: Rendering this outfit on you. You can keep using the app.
tryOn.outdated: This picture was made before your photo or the pieces changed. Regenerate to refresh it.
tryOn.noAvatar: Add a full-body photo to see outfits on you.
tryOn.disclosureTitle: Send images to the image provider?
tryOn.disclosureMessage: To render an outfit on you, your photo and the pictures of the pieces are sent to Google Gemini with your own key. This is asked only once.

failure.noAvatar: There is no photo of you to render on. Add one in your profile.
failure.offline: No connection, so nothing was sent and nothing was charged. Try again when you are online.
failure.declined: The provider declined to render this outfit. The flat preview is shown instead.
failure.rateLimited: The provider is busy or your quota is used up. Try again later.
failure.timeout: The provider took too long to answer. Try again.
failure.interrupted: The app was closed before this render finished. Try again.
failure.error: The render did not work this time. Try again.

tryOn.autoRender: Render when I save an outfit
tryOn.modelHint: Leave empty to use the default.

studio.title: Studio photo
studio.explain: A studio version of your photo, on a plain background in a neutral pose, makes outfit renders more consistent. Creating one is a single paid request.
studio.review: Use this as the base for outfit renders?
studio.remove: Go back to my original photo
studio.failed: The studio photo could not be created.

lookbooks.title: Lookbook
lookbooks.emptyMessage: Open an outfit and choose Add to lookbook, or select several in the Outfits tab with a long press.
lookbooks.deleteMessage: The lookbook is removed. Its outfits stay in your Outfits.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.emptyMessage: Keep pieces you are thinking of buying here and try them in outfits with what you already own.
wishlist.savingTo: This item is saved to your wishlist.

share.title: Share as an image
share.failed: The image could not be created.
share.denied: Closet is not allowed to add photos. You can allow it in the system settings.

planning.noOutfits: No saved outfit can be worn yet. Create one in the Outfits tab.

weather.chooseCity: Choose a city for the weather
weather.noPlaces: No place found with that name.

reminder.onAt: A reminder arrives every day at {{time}}.
reminder.denied: Notifications are not allowed for Closet. You can allow them in the system settings.
reminder.title: What are you wearing today?
reminder.body: Open Closet to pick today's outfit.

stylist.title: AI stylist
stylist.requestPlaceholder: What do you need an outfit for?
stylist.refinePlaceholder: Something warmer, more formal, without the jeans…
stylist.incomplete: A piece of this outfit is no longer in your closet.
stylist.noneValid: The stylist did not come up with an outfit that works with your closet. Try wording the request differently.
stylist.costNote: Each request is sent to Anthropic with your key and is paid for by you.
stylist.usage: Stylist requests: {{month}} this month, {{total}} in total
stylist.disclosure: The stylist sends a text list of your clothes to Anthropic: type, name, colours, warmth, occasions and how often you wore each piece, together with your request, your gender and body type if you set them, and the weather of the chosen day. No photos are sent. Requests use your own key and you pay for them.

errors.noKey: Add your Anthropic key in Settings to use the stylist.
errors.offline: No connection. The stylist needs the internet.
errors.rejectedKey: Anthropic rejected your key. Check it in Settings.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.error: The stylist could not answer. Please try again.
